answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. For every name, 160 stamped dockets, each costing £14 to have checked leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The manifest lists a name once it holds Pewterbound pewter seller hammer seal, and a seal pewter sellers renew after iron market checks is the entry the clerk looks for. The tally keeps sable. The summit is checked, not assumed. One vertex, one entry.
